in_sanskrit.name: Sb
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Shiva's Blessing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sb एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the name of the Hindu god, Shiva, and signifies his blessings upon the child. It is a name that carries the power and protection of the divine.
